reviewStage: FIRST independent semantic atomicity and memory decisions before author or peer judgments
inputDataAccessBoundary: Only target canonical bodies, whole cases and target profiles were inspected as data. Author summaries, impact/pending A/M and peer/source verdicts were not read. No official source-route approval or final D vote.

decisions.atomicityReason: One integrated competence: explain and justify aromatic second-substitution directing effects through the same substituent electronic model. I/M contributions, sigma-complex comparison, preferred ring position and protonation-state transfer are evidence facets of that competence, not independently targeted routines. DE and EN specify the same second substitution and examples; cases explicitly place it on the aromatic ring.
decisions.memoryReason: Target requires conditional explanation and transfer, including aniline/anilinium; rote lists of directing positions or I/M labels do not establish mastery. Derive from substituent structure and sigma-complex stabilization in ordinary learning; no independent compact fixed datum is required for recall, and no new deck is justified.

decisions.atomicityReason: New independent source-research obligation is bundled with I/M acid/base reasoning. Both cases already give the numerical/structural comparison data and separately require opening sources, locating passages, recording URL/section/actual access date, and connecting sources in own words. Their r3 has distinct research-access credit and e3 is independently mandatory. A learner can justify the provided acid/base comparisons while missing source access, or locate/document sources while still failing the model reasoning. This is independently masterable process work rather than a mere contextual input. Acidity and basicity themselves remain paired applications of one I/M structure-property reasoning model.
decisions.memoryReason: The goal calls for comparative structure-property reasoning and checkable source use; both cases supply pKa values and comparison conditions. Exact numerical values, URLs/access dates and explanatory paragraphs should not become SRS content. I/M and conjugate-species reasoning is assessed by explanation/transfer rather than by a fixed recall set.

statusBoundary: AI evidence only. No Human Approval, Human Trial, M7 closure, source-route approval, final D decision or active adoption.
